notes: «قال سمعت مالك بن أنس» : Sufyan heard Malik, a link; Malik asked Zayd, who answers and is the next link
«سمعت أبي يقول» : Zayd's father, named only by relation, kind relation
«قال عمر بن الخطاب» : Umar's words are the saying, so he is the last link
«فسألت النبي» in Umar's account is the Prophet in the scene, not a link
